_comment: Hand triage of every finding in corpus-results.json. A corpus count with no triage behind it is the same defect as a benchmark score with no detector behind it. Any FALSE_POSITIVE entry fails CI: the rule must be fixed and a regression fixture added, not the entry edited.

false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.class: browser-automation import treated as an agent framework
false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.fix: playwright and selenium removed from reachability.agent_frameworks — driving a browser is not agent-reachability.

false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.class: module-level script setup treated as agent-reachable
false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.fix: module-level sinks no longer yield MEDIUM confidence (reachability.module_level_reachability, default false). Module scope runs at import time and cannot be selected by an LLM — the same reasoning that already excluded __main__ blocks. Measured precision of the signal on this corpus was 0/19.
false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.regression_fixture: covered by p12 (module-level) and the corpus itself

false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.class: inter-agent transport treated as external communication
false_positives_found_and_fixed_this_run.fix: COMMUNICATION-SEND rules gained exclude_receiver_types for A2A/event-bus/runtime receivers, mirroring the existing _is_db_receiver constraint. Matches the recorded r05 negative result.

corrections.description: 2 agno findings (cookbook/.../external_tool_execution.py:29 and :38) were originally triaged as TRUE_POSITIVE. They are actually guarded by @tool(external_execution=True), agno's human-in-the-loop primitive. The scanner now recognises this flag as a framework-level guard (Work Order 4, Part 2.1). The findings no longer fire. The published precision figure in CORPUS_STUDY.md was corrected from 30/30 (100%) to 28/28 (100%) — the 2 false positives were found and fixed by the project itself before any maintainer was contacted.
